headline: New York City's subway opens
post_facts: 9.1 miles, 28 stations, City Hall to Harlem

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen oh-four... New York opened its first subway.

scenes.label: City Hall, NYC
scenes.caption: City Hall station, early 1900s
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Mayor George McClellan drove the very first train from City Hall.

scenes.label: stations over 9.1 miles, City Hall to Harlem
scenes.text: [calmly] Twenty-eight stations, over nine miles, all the way to Harlem.

scenes.label: Manhattan, 1904
scenes.caption: Under construction, 1904
scenes.text: [softly] A ride cost one nickel... and over one hundred thousand people rode that first night.

scenes.title: One line became a giant
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] That line grew into one of the world's largest subways.
